outcome: Length of second stage of labour
finding: Oxytocin administration during labour in low-risk pregnancies was associated with increased odds of caesarean section, instrumental birth, episiotomy, longer second stage of labour, and lower umbilical artery pH.
mod_finding: Oxytocin administration during labour in low-risk pregnancies was associated with increased odds of caesarean section, instrumental birth, and longer second stage of labour.
